question:
When the given figure is folded to form a cube, then which face will be on the opposite plane of 4?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2dbc8441b9e1c460be7c7dd396dcd63d7a875bdee97740d41381b2e246776926.png]
solution:
According to the given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2e4c71b27e906c4d63d7c57e96fd2d403e8b3f0cdd9cf05eb3af60611998fee.png] 

From the dice: 

6 is opposite to 3.

1 is opposite to 2.

So, face **5** will be on the opposite plane of 4.

Hence, the correct answer is **"5".**
